result: Under correctly ordered exact-authority bootstrap, the previously quarantined rmcp-v3.1.4 TaskManager update/cancel finding is promoted to current Phase-1 evidence. Exact release commit 4a738b9dd99eaca418b614afa433a0cbdaf8d056, crates/rmcp/src/task_manager.rs blob 0e8339c0a15c2b2ed32f267728fb4830e37efcdc, shows TaskManagerInner behind one Arc<Mutex<...>>. update_task and cancel_task both acquire that same mutex and run sweep_expired before mutating the task entry. update_task removes matching pending-input keys, ignores absent/already-consumed keys and dropped receivers, and returns Ok for an existing task. cancel_task sets cancel_requested=true, signals cancellation, and clears pending inputs for nonterminal tasks. Neither method accepts generation/version/prior-state/historical preconditions. Therefore this exact manager serializes in-process mutation but does not provide historical fencing: replayed consumed input responses are successful no-ops, and stale cancellation cannot be distinguished by a version predicate at this API boundary.
